parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS offer_token,
        $2::TEXT AS mobile
),

target_offer AS (
    SELECT
        offer.id AS offer_id,
        offer.waitlist_id,
        offer.offer_token,
        offer.status AS offer_status,
        offer.offered_starts_at,
        offer.offered_ends_at,
        offer.offered_at,
        offer.expires_at,
        offer.booked_appointment_id,

        waitlist.status AS waitlist_status,
        waitlist.clinic_id,
        waitlist.doctor_id,
        waitlist.patient_id,
        waitlist.service_id,
        waitlist.original_appointment_id,
        waitlist.disruption_case_id,

        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile,

        clinic.name AS clinic_name,
        clinic.timezone,

        doctor.full_name AS doctor_name,

        service.name AS service_name

    FROM appointment_waitlist_offers offer

    INNER JOIN appointment_waitlist waitlist
        ON waitlist.id = offer.waitlist_id

    INNER JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.id = waitlist.patient_id

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.id = waitlist.clinic_id

    INNER JOIN doctors doctor
        ON doctor.id = waitlist.doctor_id

    LEFT JOIN services service
        ON service.id = waitlist.service_id

    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON r.offer_token = offer.offer_token
       AND r.mobile = patient.mobile

    LIMIT 1
),

expired_offer AS (
    UPDATE appointment_waitlist_offers offer

    SET
        status = 'expired',
        responded_at = COALESCE(
            offer.responded_at,
            NOW()
        ),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM target_offer target

    WHERE offer.id = target.offer_id
      AND target.offer_status = 'offered'
      AND target.expires_at <= NOW()

    RETURNING
        offer.id AS offer_id,
        offer.waitlist_id
),

reactivated_waitlist AS (
    UPDATE appointment_waitlist waitlist

    SET
        status = 'active',
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM expired_offer expired

    WHERE waitlist.id = expired.waitlist_id
      AND waitlist.status = 'offered'

    RETURNING waitlist.id
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_offer
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN (
            SELECT offer_status
            FROM target_offer
        ) <> 'offered'
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN (
            SELECT expires_at
            FROM target_offer
        ) <= NOW()
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN (
            SELECT waitlist_status
            FROM target_offer
        ) <> 'offered'
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS processable,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_offer
        )
            THEN 'offer_not_found'

        WHEN (
            SELECT offer_status
            FROM target_offer
        ) = 'accepted'
            THEN 'offer_already_accepted'

        WHEN (
            SELECT offer_status
            FROM target_offer
        ) = 'declined'
            THEN 'offer_already_declined'

        WHEN (
            SELECT offer_status
            FROM target_offer
        ) = 'expired'
            THEN 'offer_expired'

        WHEN (
            SELECT offer_status
            FROM target_offer
        ) = 'cancelled'
            THEN 'offer_cancelled'

        WHEN (
            SELECT expires_at
            FROM target_offer
        ) <= NOW()
            THEN 'offer_expired'

        WHEN (
            SELECT waitlist_status
            FROM target_offer
        ) <> 'offered'
            THEN 'waitlist_not_offered'

        ELSE 'offer_ready'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM target_offer
        )
            THEN 'پیشنهاد مطابق توکن و شماره موبایل واردشده پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN (
            SELECT offer_status
            FROM target_offer
        ) = 'accepted'
            THEN 'این پیشنهاد قبلاً پذیرفته شده است.'

        WHEN (
            SELECT offer_status
            FROM target_offer
        ) = 'declined'
            THEN 'این پیشنهاد قبلاً رد شده است.'

        WHEN (
            SELECT offer_status
            FROM target_offer
        ) = 'cancelled'
            THEN 'این پیشنهاد دیگر فعال نیست.'

        WHEN (
            SELECT offer_status
            FROM target_offer
        ) = 'expired'
            THEN 'زمان اعتبار این پیشنهاد به پایان رسیده است.'

        WHEN (
            SELECT expires_at
            FROM target_offer
        ) <= NOW()
            THEN 'زمان اعتبار این پیشنهاد به پایان رسیده و بیمار به صف انتظار بازگشت.'

        WHEN (
            SELECT waitlist_status
            FROM target_offer
        ) <> 'offered'
            THEN 'وضعیت فعلی لیست انتظار اجازه ثبت پاسخ این پیشنهاد را نمی‌دهد.'

        ELSE 'پیشنهاد آماده ثبت پاسخ بیمار است.'
    END AS message,

    (
        SELECT offer_id
        FROM target_offer
    ) AS offer_id,

    (
        SELECT waitlist_id
        FROM target_offer
    ) AS waitlist_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_name
        FROM target_offer
    ) AS patient_name,

    (
        SELECT mobile
        FROM target_offer
    ) AS mobile,

    (
        SELECT clinic_name
        FROM target_offer
    ) AS clinic_name,

    (
        SELECT doctor_name
        FROM target_offer
    ) AS doctor_name,

    (
        SELECT service_name
        FROM target_offer
    ) AS service_name,

    (
        SELECT offered_starts_at
        FROM target_offer
    ) AS offered_starts_at,

    (
        SELECT offered_ends_at
        FROM target_offer
    ) AS offered_ends_at,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            offered_starts_at
            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
        )
        FROM target_offer
    ) AS offered_appointment_start,

    (
        SELECT expires_at
        FROM target_offer
    ) AS expires_at

FROM request_data;

WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS offer_token,
        $2::TEXT AS mobile,
        $3::TEXT AS response_note
),

offer_context AS (
    SELECT
        offer.id AS offer_id,
        offer.waitlist_id,
        offer.offer_token,
        offer.offered_starts_at,
        offer.offered_ends_at,

        waitlist.clinic_id,
        waitlist.doctor_id,
        waitlist.patient_id,
        waitlist.service_id,
        waitlist.original_appointment_id,
        waitlist.disruption_case_id,

        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile,

        clinic.name AS clinic_name,
        clinic.timezone,

        doctor.full_name AS doctor_name,

        service.name AS service_name,

        original.visit_reason,

        r.response_note

    FROM appointment_waitlist_offers offer

    INNER JOIN appointment_waitlist waitlist
        ON waitlist.id = offer.waitlist_id

    INNER JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.id = waitlist.patient_id

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.id = waitlist.clinic_id

    INNER JOIN doctors doctor
        ON doctor.id = waitlist.doctor_id

    LEFT JOIN services service
        ON service.id = waitlist.service_id

    LEFT JOIN appointments original
        ON original.id = waitlist.original_appointment_id

    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON r.offer_token = offer.offer_token
       AND r.mobile = patient.mobile

    WHERE offer.status = 'offered'
      AND offer.expires_at > NOW()
      AND waitlist.status = 'offered'

    LIMIT 1
),

slot_state AS (
    SELECT
        context.*,

        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM schedule_exceptions exception

            WHERE exception.doctor_id =
                  context.doctor_id

              AND exception.is_active = TRUE
              AND exception.exception_type =
                  'unavailable'

              AND exception.starts_at <
                    context.offered_ends_at

              AND exception.ends_at >
                    context.offered_starts_at
        ) AS is_blocked,

        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM appointments existing

            WHERE existing.doctor_id =
                  context.doctor_id

              AND existing.status IN (
                  'pending',
                  'confirmed'
              )

              AND existing.starts_at <
                    context.offered_ends_at

              AND existing.ends_at >
                    context.offered_starts_at
        ) AS has_appointment_conflict

    FROM offer_context context
),

inserted_appointment AS (
    INSERT INTO appointments (
        clinic_id,
        doctor_id,
        patient_id,
        service_id,

        starts_at,
        ends_at,

        status,
        booking_source,
        visit_reason
    )

    SELECT
        state.clinic_id,
        state.doctor_id,
        state.patient_id,
        state.service_id,

        state.offered_starts_at,
        state.offered_ends_at,

        'confirmed',
        'assistant',

        COALESCE(
            state.visit_reason,
            'ثبت نوبت از لیست انتظار'
        )

    FROM slot_state state

    WHERE state.offered_starts_at > NOW()
      AND state.is_blocked = FALSE
      AND state.has_appointment_conflict = FALSE

    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        id AS appointment_id,
        clinic_id,
        doctor_id,
        patient_id,
        service_id,
        starts_at,
        ends_at,
        status
),

accepted_offer AS (
    UPDATE appointment_waitlist_offers offer

    SET
        status = 'accepted',
        responded_at = NOW(),
        response_note = context.response_note,
        booked_appointment_id =
            appointment.appointment_id,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM offer_context context

    INNER JOIN inserted_appointment appointment
        ON TRUE

    WHERE offer.id = context.offer_id
      AND offer.status = 'offered'

    RETURNING
        offer.id AS offer_id,
        offer.booked_appointment_id
),

booked_waitlist AS (
    UPDATE appointment_waitlist waitlist

    SET
        status = 'booked',
        booked_appointment_id =
            appointment.appointment_id,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM offer_context context

    INNER JOIN inserted_appointment appointment
        ON TRUE

    INNER JOIN accepted_offer accepted
        ON accepted.offer_id = context.offer_id

    WHERE waitlist.id = context.waitlist_id
      AND waitlist.status = 'offered'

    RETURNING
        waitlist.id AS waitlist_id,
        waitlist.status AS waitlist_status,
        waitlist.booked_appointment_id
),

resolved_disruption AS (
    UPDATE appointment_disruption_cases disruption

    SET
        status = 'rescheduled',
        patient_decision = 'reschedule',

        selected_starts_at =
            appointment.starts_at,

        selected_ends_at =
            appointment.ends_at,

        decision_note =
            context.response_note,

        responded_at = COALESCE(
            disruption.responded_at,
            NOW()
        ),

        resolved_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM offer_context context

    INNER JOIN inserted_appointment appointment
        ON TRUE

    INNER JOIN booked_waitlist booked
        ON booked.waitlist_id =
           context.waitlist_id

    WHERE disruption.id =
          context.disruption_case_id

    RETURNING disruption.id
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM offer_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM slot_state
            WHERE is_blocked = TRUE
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM slot_state
            WHERE has_appointment_conflict = TRUE
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_appointment
        )
            THEN TRUE

        ELSE FALSE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM offer_context
        )
            THEN 'offer_not_processable'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM slot_state
            WHERE is_blocked = TRUE
        )
            THEN 'offered_slot_blocked'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM slot_state
            WHERE has_appointment_conflict = TRUE
        )
            THEN 'offered_slot_unavailable'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_appointment
        )
            THEN 'waitlist_offer_accepted'

        ELSE 'booking_conflict'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM offer_context
        )
            THEN 'پیشنهاد دیگر قابل پردازش نیست.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM slot_state
            WHERE is_blocked = TRUE
        )
            THEN 'زمان پیشنهادی اکنون در برنامه پزشک مسدود شده است.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM slot_state
            WHERE has_appointment_conflict = TRUE
        )
            THEN 'زمان پیشنهادی دیگر در دسترس نیست.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_appointment
        )
            THEN 'پیشنهاد پذیرفته و نوبت بیمار ثبت شد.'

        ELSE 'در فاصله پذیرش پیشنهاد تا ثبت نوبت، وضعیت زمان تغییر کرده است.'
    END AS message,

    (
        SELECT appointment_id
        FROM inserted_appointment
    ) AS appointment_id,

    (
        SELECT offer_id
        FROM accepted_offer
    ) AS offer_id,

    (
        SELECT waitlist_id
        FROM booked_waitlist
    ) AS waitlist_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_name
        FROM offer_context
    ) AS patient_name,

    (
        SELECT mobile
        FROM offer_context
    ) AS mobile,

    (
        SELECT doctor_name
        FROM offer_context
    ) AS doctor_name,

    (
        SELECT service_name
        FROM offer_context
    ) AS service_name,

    (
        SELECT starts_at
        FROM inserted_appointment
    ) AS starts_at,

    (
        SELECT ends_at
        FROM inserted_appointment
    ) AS ends_at,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            appointment.starts_at
            AT TIME ZONE context.timezone,
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
        )
        FROM inserted_appointment appointment
        CROSS JOIN offer_context context
    ) AS appointment_start,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM inserted_appointment
    ) AS appointment_status

FROM request_data;

parameters.query:
UPDATE appointments
SET
    google_calendar_event_id = $1,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $2
RETURNING
    id AS appointment_id,
    google_calendar_event_id;

WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS offer_token,
        $2::TEXT AS mobile,
        $3::TEXT AS response_note
),

offer_context AS (
    SELECT
        offer.id AS offer_id,
        offer.waitlist_id,

        waitlist.disruption_case_id,

        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile,

        doctor.full_name AS doctor_name,
        service.name AS service_name,

        r.response_note

    FROM appointment_waitlist_offers offer

    INNER JOIN appointment_waitlist waitlist
        ON waitlist.id = offer.waitlist_id

    INNER JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.id = waitlist.patient_id

    INNER JOIN doctors doctor
        ON doctor.id = waitlist.doctor_id

    LEFT JOIN services service
        ON service.id = waitlist.service_id

    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON r.offer_token = offer.offer_token
       AND r.mobile = patient.mobile

    WHERE offer.status = 'offered'
      AND offer.expires_at > NOW()
      AND waitlist.status = 'offered'

    LIMIT 1
),

declined_offer AS (
    UPDATE appointment_waitlist_offers offer

    SET
        status = 'declined',
        responded_at = NOW(),
        response_note = context.response_note,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM offer_context context

    WHERE offer.id = context.offer_id
      AND offer.status = 'offered'

    RETURNING
        offer.id AS offer_id,
        offer.waitlist_id
),

reactivated_waitlist AS (
    UPDATE appointment_waitlist waitlist

    SET
        status = 'active',
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM declined_offer declined

    WHERE waitlist.id = declined.waitlist_id
      AND waitlist.status = 'offered'

    RETURNING
        waitlist.id AS waitlist_id,
        waitlist.status AS waitlist_status
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM reactivated_waitlist
        )
            THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM reactivated_waitlist
        )
            THEN 'waitlist_offer_declined'
        ELSE 'decline_conflict'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM reactivated_waitlist
        )
            THEN 'پیشنهاد رد شد و بیمار در لیست انتظار فعال باقی ماند.'
        ELSE 'در فاصله بررسی تا ثبت پاسخ، وضعیت پیشنهاد تغییر کرده است.'
    END AS message,

    (
        SELECT offer_id
        FROM declined_offer
    ) AS offer_id,

    (
        SELECT waitlist_id
        FROM reactivated_waitlist
    ) AS waitlist_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_name
        FROM offer_context
    ) AS patient_name,

    (
        SELECT mobile
        FROM offer_context
    ) AS mobile,

    (
        SELECT doctor_name
        FROM offer_context
    ) AS doctor_name,

    (
        SELECT service_name
        FROM offer_context
    ) AS service_name,

    'offer_to_next_patient'::TEXT
        AS next_action

FROM request_data;

parameters.content:
## پردازش پاسخ پیشنهاد لیست انتظار

1. ابتدا Workflow شماره 24 را فقط یک‌بار اجرا کن.

2. `offer_token` را از خروجی Workflow شماره 23 بردار.

3. پاسخ‌های مجاز:
- `accept`: نوبت ثبت و Calendar ساخته می‌شود.
- `decline`: پیشنهاد رد و بیمار دوباره active می‌شود.

4. پیشنهاد منقضی‌شده خودکار expired شده و بیمار به صف بازمی‌گردد.

5. مقدار پیش‌فرض تست روی decline است تا نوبت ناخواسته ساخته نشود.
